papers.title: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
papers.abstract: Abstract  We introduce LimiX-2, a new model in the LimiX family, developed through model and data scaling guided by our previously established scaling laws. LimiX-2 adopts the Contextual Mechanism Networks (CMNs) paradigm and is pretrained with Context-Conditional Masked Modeling (CCMM). CMNs shifts the organizing principle of in-context learning from target-centric prediction to mechanism-oriented joint modeling. Rather than centering the network on the p(y mid x, D_{context}) objective of conventional tabular PFNs, it is designed around learning p(x, y mid D_{context}), a context-dependent representation of the joint structure underlying data generation. Pretraining uses synthetic datasets generated by structural causal models (SCMs) spanning diverse graph structures, functional mechanisms, and observation processes. Evaluations on TabArena, TALENT, and BCCO show that LimiX-2 outperforms current dataset-specific models and tabular foundation models. Beyond predictive performance, the CMN paradigm also promotes causal awareness in LimiX-2: its feature attention encodes direct causal relationships, enabling accurate causal skeleton recovery.

ru.title: От прогнозирования к причинному пониманию табличных данных
ru.desc: Представлена модель LimiX-2, разработанная путём масштабирования параметров и данных согласно установленным законам масштабирования. Модель использует парадигму сетей контекстных механизмов (CMNs) и обучается методом контекстно-условного маскированного моделирования (CCMM), который смещает фокус с прогнозирования целевой переменной на совместное моделирование входных и выходных данных на основе контекста. Предварительное обучение осуществляется на синтетических датасетах, сгенерированных структурными причинными моделями (SCMs) с различными графическими структурами и механизмами. LimiX-2 превосходит существующие табличные модели на бенчмарках и демонстрирует способность восстанавливать причинные связи через механизм внимания признаков.

en.title: LimiX-2: Advancing Causal Awareness in Machine Learning
en.desc: LimiX-2 is a new machine learning model that enhances in-context learning by shifting focus from target-centric predictions to joint modeling of data. It utilizes Contextual Mechanism Networks (CMNs) and is pretrained using Context-Conditional Masked Modeling (CCMM) on synthetic datasets created by structural causal models. This approach allows LimiX-2 to learn a context-dependent representation of the data, improving its understanding of the underlying causal relationships. Evaluations demonstrate that LimiX-2 outperforms existing models in predictive tasks while also enhancing causal awareness through its feature attention mechanism.

zh.title: LimiX-2：因果意识与上下文建模的结合
zh.desc: LimiX-2是LimiX系列中的新模型，采用了基于先前建立的缩放法则进行模型和数据的扩展。该模型使用上下文机制网络（CMNs）范式，并通过上下文条件掩蔽建模（CCMM）进行预训练。CMNs将上下文学习的组织原则从以目标为中心的预测转变为以机制为导向的联合建模，旨在学习数据生成的上下文依赖表示。LimiX-2在多个评估任务中表现优于现有的数据集特定模型和表格基础模型，同时也增强了因果意识，能够准确恢复因果结构。

papers.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
papers.abstract: Abstract  Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria, agents transform repositories into executable environments that support task generation, execution, and scientific verification. These environments provide a shared foundation for supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. Using verified interaction trajectories, we train PhAI-IDE-72B, PhAI-IDE-9B, and PhAI-IDE-4B. The model family shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning, and knowledge, providing evidence of positive transfer from scientific experience to broader capabilities. ScienceIDE lays the foundation for an integrated workspace for agent learning and scientific practice, making humanity's scientific software a shared substrate for developing scientific intelligence. Code: https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE

ru.title: Научный код как единая база для обучения агентов и развития научного интеллекта
ru.desc: Статья представляет ScienceIDE — инфраструктуру для преобразования научного кода из открытых репозиториев в программируемые окружения для обучения агентов. Авторы решают проблему фрагментированности научных инструментов и неявных соглашений, которые затрудняют использование научного кода как обучающего материала. С помощью проверенных траекторий взаимодействия они обучают семейство моделей PhAI-IDE разных размеров (72B, 9B, 4B параметров), используя методы supervised fine-tuning и reinforcement learning. Модели демонстрируют улучшение в задачах исправления научного кода и положительный перенос знаний на общие бенчмарки в области программирования, рассуждений и знаний.

en.title: Transforming Scientific Code into AI Learning Environments
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of converting scientific code into reliable learning experiences, which is hindered by fragmented tools and implicit conventions. The authors introduce ScienceIDE, a framework that transforms scientific code repositories into programmable environments for AI agents. These environments enable task generation, execution, and verification, supporting various machine learning approaches like supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. The resulting model family demonstrates improved performance in scientific code repair and general benchmarks, showcasing the potential for scientific knowledge to enhance AI capabilities.

zh.title: 打破科学体验瓶颈，构建智能学习环境
zh.desc: 科学代码库包含了数十年的可执行模型、方法和工具的知识。然而，工具链的碎片化、隐含的领域约定和特定的正确性标准使得将这些知识转化为可靠的学习体验变得困难，这被称为科学体验瓶颈。我们提出了ScienceIDE，这是一种基础设施，可以将全球的科学代码转化为可编程的科学代理环境。在专家定义的科学案例和接受标准的指导下，代理将代码库转化为支持任务生成、执行和科学验证的可执行环境。

papers.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
papers.abstract: Abstract  In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates. However, we uncover a systematic failure mode in PPO critics, which we call Value Flattening: state values, estimated from multiple Monte Carlo continuations, change sharply across intermediate states while critic predictions remain comparatively flat. We further observe this phenomenon in a controlled FrozenLake environment and find that it becomes more pronounced as the state space grows. Our theoretical and empirical analyses relate Value Flattening to an implicit variance penalty in the critic loss and redundant updates from temporally correlated states with similar gradients. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP^3O), which applies the value loss to only a few well-separated states in each response to mitigate both effects. Experiments on Qwen3-Base show that SP^3O with only three states supervised per response can mitigate Value Flattening and consistently improve the learned policy across model sizes and evaluation suites. Together, our results identify Value Flattening as an important yet overlooked failure mode of critic learning in standard PPO and show that a simple sparse supervision strategy can mitigate it.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Решение проблемы Value Flattening в PPO через разреженный контроль
ru.desc: В статье выявлена критическая проблема в обучении LLM с использованием PPO, называемая Value Flattening: оценки состояний, полученные из разных Monte Carlo продолжений, резко изменяются между промежуточными состояниями, но предсказания критика остаются почти плоскими. Авторы показали, что это явление связано с неявным штрафом на дисперсию в функции потерь критика и избыточными обновлениями из временно коррелированных состояний. Они предложили SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP³O), которая применяет функцию потерь значений только к нескольким хорошо разделённым состояниям в каждом ответе. Эксперименты на модели Qwen3-Base демонстрируют, что SP³O с тремя контролируемыми состояниями на ответ эффективно решает проблему Value Flattening и улучшает качество обучаемой политики.

en.title: Mitigating Value Flattening in PPO with Sparse Supervision
en.desc: This paper discusses a problem in reinforcement learning using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) where the critic's state value estimates become too uniform, a phenomenon termed Value Flattening. This issue leads to ineffective policy updates, especially as the complexity of the state space increases. The authors propose a new method called SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP^3O), which focuses on applying value loss to only a few distinct states to reduce the negative effects of Value Flattening. Their experiments demonstrate that this approach can enhance the performance of the learned policy across various model sizes and evaluation scenarios.

zh.title: 稀疏策略优化：解决值平坦化问题
zh.desc: 在强化学习中，近端策略优化（PPO）通常使用评论家来估计状态值并减少策略更新的方差。然而，我们发现PPO评论家存在一种系统性失败模式，称为值平坦化：从多个蒙特卡洛延续中估计的状态值在中间状态之间变化剧烈，而评论家的预测相对平坦。我们在受控的FrozenLake环境中观察到这一现象，并发现随着状态空间的增长，这种现象变得更加明显。基于这些发现，我们提出了稀疏近端策略优化（SP^3O），该方法仅对每个响应中的少数几个分离状态应用值损失，从而减轻了值平坦化的问题。

papers.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry. Existing confidence estimators, however, share one design premise: they only read the current inference process, either by introspecting on it, scoring its token probabilities, or resampling it. We argue that the current inference is not a sufficient basis for confidence. We propose XConf (eXperiential Confidence): estimating confidence together with the model's accumulated experience. The experience is stored as a record of the model's own graded past episodes, each holding the task, the model's reflection, its stated confidence, the outcome, and a lesson written once the grade arrived. Given a new task, XConf's Recall stage retrieves past episodes on similar tasks met with a similar stated confidence, and reads off their historical success rate; its Reflect stage shows the model this record, has it name its recurring failure mode, and restate a confidence now informed by its own track records. Our estimator is format-general, requiring no logit access or weight updates, and costs only one answer generation. Across nine benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, multimodal QA, and interactive agents, and four models from three families, XConf beats or matches ten-sample self-consistency in discrimination (AUROC) on 23 of 24 comparisons, with much lower calibration error (ECE), at a tenth of the generation cost. Used for selective prediction, abstaining on the 10% least-confident episodes raises the delivered success rate by up to 8.7 points on agent tasks. We therefore see experiential confidence estimation as a new paradigm for future general-purpose confidence estimation.

ru.title: Опыт как основа доверия: уверенность языковых моделей из памяти прошлого
ru.desc: Статья предлагает новый подход к оценке уверенности (confidence estimation) языковых моделей, называемый XConf, который основан на накопленном опыте модели. Вместо того чтобы анализировать только текущий процесс вывода, метод сохраняет записи о прошлых задачах, ответах модели, её рефлексии и результатах, а затем использует эту историю для более точного прогнозирования надёжности новых ответов. XConf работает в два этапа: сначала извлекает похожие прошлые примеры с аналогичной уверенностью (Recall), а затем показывает модели эту историю, чтобы она пересмотрела свою оценку уверенности (Reflect). Метод демонстрирует превосходные результаты на девяти бенчмарках, обеспечивая лучшую калибровку и дискриминативность при значительно меньших вычислительных затратах.

en.title: XConf: Learning Confidence from Experience
en.desc: This paper introduces XConf (eXperiential Confidence), a novel method for estimating the confidence of language models based on their past experiences rather than just the current inference process. XConf maintains a record of previous tasks, including the model's confidence levels and outcomes, allowing it to learn from its history. When faced with a new task, XConf retrieves similar past episodes to inform its confidence estimation, enhancing its accuracy. The results show that XConf outperforms traditional methods in various benchmarks while being more efficient and requiring fewer resources.

zh.title: 经验置信度：提升语言模型可靠性的新时代
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的置信度估计方法，称为XConf（经验置信度），旨在提高语言模型的可靠性。与传统方法仅依赖当前推理过程不同，XConf结合了模型的历史经验，通过记录过去的任务和结果来进行置信度估计。该方法通过回忆相似任务的历史成功率和反思模型的失败模式，来调整当前任务的置信度。实验结果表明，XConf在多个基准测试中表现优异，显著降低了校准误差，并提高了选择性预测的成功率。

papers.title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract  Coding agents are typically evaluated with desired behavior specified through issues or instructions. In practical web development, however, agents may need to infer behavior from working software and implement it in an incomplete application. We introduce ProgramDistill, a benchmark evaluating coding agents on features discovered through interaction with fully functional reference applications. We build ProgramDistill by factorizing applications into features of different granularities, each associated with replayable behaviors executable via its gold patch. Our pipeline, mine-craft-patch, discovers 1,975 replay-verified behaviors across 26 applications and constructs 4,063 tasks without human intervention. Across nine frontier coding agents, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 achieve 49.2% and 28.8% success on cumulative workflows in full-application reconstruction. In partial-application reconstruction, success falls from 100% to 64.0% and from 96% to 32% as restoration depth increases from 1 to 8. ProgramDistill thus provides a scalable benchmark with controlled difficulty for evaluating and diagnosing coding agents, and a natural basis for future curriculum-based training.

ru.title: Обучение кодирующих агентов через инверсию готового программного обеспечения
ru.desc: Авторы представляют ProgramDistill — benchmark для оценки кодирующих агентов, которые должны изучать функциональность рабочего программного обеспечения и реализовывать её в неполных приложениях. Бенчмарк построен путём факторизации приложений на признаки различной гранулярности с использованием pipeline mine-craft-patch, который автоматически обнаруживает 1,975 воспроизводимых поведений в 26 приложениях и генерирует 4,063 задачи без участия человека. Тестирование девяти frontier LLM-агентов показало, что лучшие модели (GPT-6 Astra и Claude Opus 5) достигают 49.2% и 28.8% успеха при полной реконструкции приложения, но точность падает с 100% до 64% при увеличении глубины восстановления. Данный benchmark обеспечивает масштабируемую оценку с контролируемой сложностью для диагностики кодирующих агентов и создаёт основу для будущего curriculum learning.

en.title: Evaluating Coding Agents Through Behavior Inference from Functional Software
en.desc: This paper presents ProgramDistill, a new benchmark for evaluating coding agents based on their ability to learn from fully functional software applications. It focuses on how agents can infer and implement desired behaviors from existing code rather than just following explicit instructions. The authors developed a pipeline called mine-craft-patch that automatically discovers and verifies a large number of coding behaviors across various applications. The results show that while coding agents perform well in reconstructing full applications, their success rate significantly drops when tasked with partial applications, highlighting the challenges in coding agent performance evaluation.

zh.title: ProgramDistill：评估编码代理的新基准
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种新的基准测试工具ProgramDistill，用于评估编码代理的能力。该工具通过与功能完整的参考应用程序交互，提取出不同粒度的特征，并将其与可重放的行为关联。我们的方法mine-craft-patch能够在没有人工干预的情况下发现1975种经过重放验证的行为，并构建4063个任务。实验结果显示，GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在完整应用重建中的成功率分别为49.2%和28.8%，而在部分应用重建中，成功率随着恢复深度的增加而显著下降。

papers.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
papers.abstract: Abstract  Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. Run several of them and each session starts from scratch, so more agents tend to mean more duplicated search rather than more discovery. Agora is a shared memory for such agents: research is recorded as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) stored in Git, so that every claim is a commit anyone can check out and rerun. Each result, insight, hypothesis, verification, and report is an immutable commit whose parent edges say what it builds on; a derived index exposes the frontier, the neglected branches, and the verification status of each claim, and a diversity-aware selection rule keeps the community from collapsing onto one leader. We describe the system and report its first sustained use: a run of nearly 12 days in which 13 language-model workers, with no assigned tasks and no central planner, worked on a weight-transfer problem. Given 141 pretrained donor models and a frozen 119.6M-parameter attention-SSM hybrid whose dimensions match no donor, the workers had to initialize the target without training data or gradient updates. They published 1,703 contributions and drove the evaluator from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M. The winning recipe compresses donor next-token statistics into the target's embedding and output head, then adds a short-range context signal through sparse edits to attention, feed-forward, and state-space blocks. Its 145-commit ancestry spans 15 accounts, and 165 independent reproductions were posted, none of which failed. We describe the single mid-run human intervention that pulled the community out of a monoculture, what the trace does and does not establish, and the controlled comparison that would settle whether shared research state improves discovery per unit of compute.

ru.title: Коллективный поиск через общую память исследований
ru.desc: В работе представлена система Agora для координации множественных агентов машинного обучения, которые самостоятельно проводят исследования. Результаты работы каждого агента записываются в общую память в виде DAG (ориентированного ациклического графа), хранящегося в Git, что позволяет воспроизводить и проверять любые утверждения. Система использует индекс производных результатов и правило отбора, учитывающее разнообразие, чтобы избежать концентрации на одном направлении поиска. В экспериментальной демонстрации 13 LLM-агентов независимо друг от друга работали над задачей трансфера весов между моделями в течение 12 дней, достигнув значительного улучшения метрики и создав 1,703 публикуемых вклада.

en.title: Agora: Enhancing Collaborative Discovery in Autonomous Research
en.desc: The paper presents Agora, a shared memory system designed for autonomous research agents to enhance collaborative machine learning efforts. By storing research as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) in Git, Agora allows agents to document their findings and hypotheses in a verifiable manner. This system prevents redundancy in research by enabling agents to build on each other's work while maintaining a diverse exploration of solutions. The authors demonstrate Agora's effectiveness through a 12-day experiment involving 13 language-model workers, which resulted in significant improvements in a weight-transfer problem without centralized control.

zh.title: 共享记忆提升自主研究效率
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了一个名为Agora的共享记忆系统，旨在提高自主研究循环的效率。通过将研究记录为一个不可变的有向无环图（DAG），每个研究结果都可以被检查和重现。该系统允许多个编码代理在没有中央规划者的情况下进行协作，促进了多样性并避免了研究的单一化。实验中，13个语言模型工作者在没有训练数据的情况下成功缩小了与训练好的GPT-2模型的差距，展示了共享研究状态如何提升发现的能力。

papers.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

ru.title: Сохранение физических отношений при токенизации действий для робототехники
ru.desc: В статье исследуется проблема квантизации действий в аварегрессивных видео-языковых моделях, которые преобразуют непрерывные команды в дискретные токены. Авторы предлагают новую метрику Physical Rank Consistency (PRC) для оценки того, насколько хорошо токенизация сохраняет физические отношения между действиями после сжатия, дополняя традиционные поточечные метрики. Они представляют метод ActionPiece, использующий совместное обучение с двумя целевыми функциями: сохранение порядка расстояний между действиями в представлениях и квантованных кодовых словах. Экспериментальные результаты демонстрируют, что предложенный подход достигает высокой точности на бенчмарках LIBERO и VLA-Arena, при этом правильнее сохраняя физические отношения между действиями.

en.title: Enhancing Action Tokenization with Physical Rank Consistency
en.desc: This paper introduces a new method for evaluating and improving action tokenizers in vision-language-action models. It highlights the limitations of traditional metrics like mean squared error (MSE) in capturing the true fidelity of action adjustments across different contexts. The authors propose a novel metric called physical rank consistency (PRC) to assess how well tokenization maintains the relative distances between actions after reconstruction. Additionally, they present ActionPiece, a framework that enhances action tokenization by jointly supervising representation learning and quantization to better preserve physical action relationships.

zh.title: 提升动作标记化的物理关系监督
zh.desc: 本文介绍了动作标记器在自回归视觉-语言-动作模型中的重要性，影响策略训练的目标和从预测标记中恢复的可执行命令。我们提出了物理秩一致性（PRC）来评估标记化在重建后保留局部物理距离排名的能力。通过引入ActionPiece，我们实现了对物理动作关系的保持，结合了表示学习和量化的联合监督。实验结果表明，ActionPiece在多个评估任务中表现优异，证明了物理关系监督在动作标记化中的重要性。

papers.title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
papers.abstract: Abstract  Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast. Accuracy is limited by outliers: a block's quantization scale is set by its largest entries, leaving typical entries confined to a narrow range of representable values. Prior work smooths queries and keys, but value outliers follow no fixed channel or spatiotemporal structure and remain the dominant source of output error. Speed is limited by softmax: low-bit Tensor Cores accelerate only the two matrix multiplications, so the high-precision exponential between them becomes the longest pipeline stage on datacenter GPUs. We propose VC-Attention, a training-free low-bit attention framework that addresses both by pairing Value smoothing with a fused probability Cast. V-Smooth reorders value tokens by lightweight online clustering, so the tokens in a hardware block quantize well together. It quantizes only the residual after subtracting the block mean, and restores that mean from the row sum the online softmax already maintains. ExpCast-FP8 maps log-domain scores directly to E4M3 probability codes with one fused multiply-add, eliminating the FP32 exponential and the format conversion. We implement VC-Attention for B200, B300, H200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090. Across Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, HunyuanVideo-1.5, and MiniMax-H3, VC-Attention improves fidelity over low-bit baselines, speeds up the attention kernel over BF16 FlashAttention-4 by 1.46-1.59x on datacenter Blackwell and Hopper and by 2.3-3.6x on workstation cards, and generates a clip 1.13-1.19x and 1.36-1.70x faster end to end.

ru.title: Низкобитовое внимание для быстрой генерации видео без потери качества
ru.desc: В работе предложен метод VC-Attention для эффективного развёртывания трансформеров генерации видео с низкой разрядностью. Основная проблема состоит в том, что механизм внимания требует больших вычислительных затрат на длинных последовательностях, а выбросы в данных приводят к потере точности при квантизации. Авторы решают эту задачу двумя инновациями: V-Smooth переупорядочивает токены значений через онлайн-кластеризацию для лучшей квантизации, а ExpCast-FP8 ускоряет вычисление вероятностей, устраняя дорогостоящую FP32-экспоненциальную операцию. Экспериментальные результаты показывают ускорение внимания в 1.46-3.6x раза в зависимости от аппаратуры при сохранении качества видеогенерации.

en.title: Boosting Video Generation with Efficient Low-Bit Attention
en.desc: This paper introduces VC-Attention, a novel low-bit attention framework designed to enhance video generation using Diffusion Transformers. It addresses the challenges of accuracy and speed in attention mechanisms by implementing Value smoothing and a fused probability Cast. The method improves the quantization of value tokens, allowing for better representation of typical entries while reducing the impact of outliers. Additionally, VC-Attention significantly accelerates the attention kernel, achieving faster processing times on various hardware setups while maintaining high fidelity in generated video outputs.

zh.title: VC-Attention：提升视频生成的低比特注意力框架
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为VC-Attention的低比特注意力框架，旨在提高视频生成的准确性和速度。通过对值进行平滑处理和融合概率映射，VC-Attention有效地解决了量化误差和计算瓶颈的问题。该方法通过轻量级在线聚类重新排序值令牌，使其在硬件块中更好地量化。实验结果表明，VC-Attention在多个数据集上显著提高了生成视频的质量，并加速了注意力计算。

papers.title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.

ru.title: Самообучающаяся торговая политика через эволюцию системного промпта
ru.desc: В статье представлена система EvolveTrade, которая позволяет торговым агентам на основе больших языковых моделей адаптировать свои стратегии во время работы. Вместо использования фиксированной политики, установленной перед развёртыванием, система динамически обновляет системный промпт агента на основе накопленных данных о принятых решениях и результатов портфеля. После каждого интервала обновления специальный Policy Agent анализирует историю торговых операций и пересматривает инструкции для основного LLM, сохраняя его неизменным. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что самоэволюционирующие политики повышают коэффициент Шарпа и совокупную доходность, при этом агент автоматически адаптирует методы сбора информации и конструирования портфеля к изменяющимся рыночным условиям.

en.title: EvolveTrade: Adapting Trading Strategies for Dynamic Markets
en.desc: The paper presents EvolveTrade, a novel framework for large language model (LLM) trading agents that enhances their adaptability in dynamic market conditions. Instead of relying on static, pre-defined policies, EvolveTrade allows a Policy Agent to continuously update the trading strategy based on past decisions and portfolio performance. This self-evolving approach enables the agent to improve its methods for gathering information and constructing portfolios over time. Experimental results demonstrate that EvolveTrade significantly outperforms traditional fixed-policy models in terms of Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return, indicating its effectiveness in real-world trading scenarios.

zh.title: 自我进化的交易代理，提升市场适应能力
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为EvolveTrade的自我进化框架，旨在提升大型语言模型（LLM）交易代理的灵活性。传统的交易代理依赖于静态的手写工具使用政策，限制了它们在市场变化时的适应能力。EvolveTrade通过将工具使用代理的系统提示视为文本参数化政策，使得代理能够根据决策轨迹和投资组合反馈不断修正其政策。实验结果表明，EvolveTrade在多个市场环境中相较于固定政策的LLM基线，通常能提高夏普比率和累计收益。

papers.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
papers.abstract: Abstract  We introduce Zing-0.5, a 5B autoregressive world model designed for playability: users can explore generated worlds, influence unfolding events, and respond to the resulting feedback through joint keyboard and online text control. Our approach brings together three technical contributions: (1) Unified action and text conditioning, combining magnitude-aware keyboard inputs with temporally aligned text instructions and jointly annotated videos to learn navigation and event control within the same sequence; (2) Event-scale supervision for incremental generation, using a segment-level teacher trained on connected multi-prompt videos to supervise a block-level causal student through distribution-matching distillation; and (3) Low-cost real-time interaction, combining four-step generation with context-preserving streaming to support 832 x 480 inference at 24 FPS at an estimated server rental cost of approximately USD 0.009 per stream-minute. Zing-0.5 achieves an overall score of 81.0 and a consistency score of 88.5 across 158 WBench Navigation cases. A joint-control demonstration shows a text-directed event change during continued navigation without restarting generation. We release the model weights, inference code, and Zing-SGLang serving implementation to support further work on playable generated worlds.

ru.title: Интерактивные игровые миры через управляемую видеогенерацию
ru.desc: Представлена Zing-0.5 — генеративная модель размером 5 миллиардов параметров, которая создаёт интерактивные виртуальные миры, позволяя пользователям управлять событиями через клавиатуру и текстовые команды одновременно. Ключевой вклад включает объединённое кондиционирование действий и текста, где модель учится на видео с аннотациями навигации и управления событиями в едином потоке данных. Авторы применили дистилляцию знаний на уровне блоков, используя учитель, обученный на многопромптных видео, для контроля студента через сопоставление распределений. Система достигает высокой производительности (24 FPS при разрешении 832x480) с минимальными вычислительными затратами благодаря четырёхшаговой генерации и потоковой обработке.

en.title: Explore and Influence: Zing-0.5's Playable Worlds
en.desc: Zing-0.5 is a 5 billion parameter autoregressive model that allows users to interactively explore and influence generated worlds. It integrates keyboard inputs and text instructions to control navigation and events in a unified manner. The model employs event-scale supervision for better incremental generation, using a teacher-student framework to enhance learning efficiency. With real-time interaction capabilities, Zing-0.5 operates at a low cost while maintaining high performance in navigation tasks.

zh.title: Zing-0.5：可玩生成世界的新探索
zh.desc: Zing-0.5 是一个5B自回归世界模型，旨在提高可玩性。用户可以探索生成的世界，影响事件的发展，并通过键盘和在线文本控制进行反馈。该模型结合了统一的动作和文本条件、事件规模的监督以及低成本的实时交互，支持高效的生成和控制。Zing-0.5 在158个WBench导航案例中取得了81.0的整体得分和88.5的一致性得分，并提供了模型权重和推理代码以支持后续研究。

papers.title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
papers.abstract: Abstract  Scientific agents contribute to hypothesis discovery by synthesizing evidence, assessing proposals, and developing new explanations. Recent systems combine scientific agents with evolutionary search through critique, comparison, and revision. However, how different forms of agent collaboration affect hypothesis quality remains an open question. Answering this question requires separating the effects of agents' scientific capabilities from those of their collaboration. A framework must therefore preserve agents' scientific roles and support rules for combining, revising, and retaining hypotheses. Building on this view, we introduce HypoEvolve, which makes collaboration explicit through successive updates to a hypothesis population. Specifically, we propose a generational genetic algorithm to coordinate specialized large language model (LLM) agents that integrate mechanistic arguments, reconsider assumptions, and assess evidence and testability. Each generation specifies how scientific judgments and new proposals reshape the population, making collaboration effects on hypothesis quality directly testable. Moreover, we design our evaluation around scientifically meaningful hypotheses that explain how a proposed intervention could work. Drug repurposing links these explanations to target-level biological claims assessed against external evidence. Specifically, we adapt DepMap and Open Targets into complementary external measures grounded in experimental, genetic, and clinical evidence. Across 34 cancer types, HypoEvolve achieves the highest scores against six baselines on both measures. DepMap selectivity reaches 0.171, versus 0.115 for the strongest baseline. Gains over single-pass generation also generalize to held-out cancer types. HypoEvolve advances a vision of autonomous science in which AI research teams achieve a capacity for discovery beyond that of individual models.
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

ru.title: Эволюция гипотез через сотрудничество агентов LLM для научных открытий
ru.desc: В статье представляется HypoEvolve — система для автоматического открытия научных гипотез, которая координирует специализированные LLM-агенты через генетический алгоритм. Каждое поколение алгоритма использует разные роли агентов для интеграции механистических аргументов, переоценки предположений и проверки доказательств, что позволяет явно измерять влияние сотрудничества на качество гипотез. Система применяется к задаче репозиционирования лекарств для раковых заболеваний, где гипотезы оцениваются против внешних экспериментальных, генетических и клинических данных из DepMap и Open Targets. HypoEvolve превосходит шесть базовых подходов на 34 типах рака и демонстрирует способность AI-команды к научным открытиям, выходящим за возможности отдельных моделей.

en.title: Collaborative AI for Enhanced Hypothesis Discovery
en.desc: This paper introduces HypoEvolve, a framework that enhances hypothesis discovery by using collaborative scientific agents and evolutionary search techniques. It employs a generational genetic algorithm to manage a population of specialized large language model (LLM) agents, allowing them to critique and revise hypotheses based on mechanistic arguments and evidence. The framework explicitly tracks how collaboration among agents influences the quality of hypotheses, making it possible to test these effects directly. The results demonstrate that HypoEvolve outperforms existing methods in generating scientifically meaningful hypotheses, particularly in the context of drug repurposing across various cancer types.

zh.title: HypoEvolve：推动科学发现的AI协作框架
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为HypoEvolve的框架，旨在通过科学代理的协作来提高假设的质量。该框架结合了进化搜索和大型语言模型（LLM）代理，能够整合机制论证、重新考虑假设并评估证据和可测试性。HypoEvolve通过世代遗传算法明确协作过程，使得科学判断和新提案能够直接影响假设群体的演变。研究表明，HypoEvolve在34种癌症类型中表现优异，超越了六个基线模型，展示了AI研究团队在科学发现方面的潜力。

papers.title: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recently, linear attention layers have been increasingly adopted to replace softmax attention at scale for long-context modeling. However, existing context extension approaches typically apply continued pretraining directly without modifying these layers, overlooking the spectral properties of linear attention state dynamics. In this work, we study long-context extension of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) from a spectral perspective of transition matrix and identify two essential factors governing long-range information retrieval: (1) a sufficiently broad slow spectral band aligned with the target dependency length, and (2) the preservation of fast-decaying modes for state clearing and context switching. Based on this observation, we propose SpectralShift, a spectral reparameterization approach for long-context continual pretraining of GDNs. Specifically, SpectralShift reparameterizes the alpha projections initialization to reshape the decay spectrum by enhancing slow propagation capacity, and further introduces a learning-rate scaling for alpha projections to facilitate long-context training. Experiments show that SpectralShift consistently improves long-context capabilities over training, providing an effective and efficient solution for extending context windows of linear attention models. The code has been open-sourced at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/GDN-SpectralShift.
affiliations: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

ru.title: Спектральная перестройка для расширения контекста в линейных моделях внимания
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема расширения контекста для моделей с линейным вниманием, в частности для Gated DeltaNet, с использованием спектрального анализа матриц переходов. Авторы выявили два ключевых фактора для эффективного извлечения информации на длинных дистанциях: наличие широкой полосы медленных собственных значений, соответствующей целевой длине зависимостей, и сохранение быстро затухающих мод для очистки состояния. На основе этих наблюдений предложен метод SpectralShift, который перепараметризирует инициализацию проекций alpha для изменения спектра затухания и использует масштабирование скорости обучения для улучшения обучения на длинных контекстах. Экспериментальные результаты демонстрируют, что SpectralShift эффективно улучшает способность моделей работать с расширенными контекстами.

en.title: Enhancing Long-Context Modeling with SpectralShift
en.desc: This paper introduces SpectralShift, a new method for improving long-context modeling in linear attention layers, specifically for Gated DeltaNet (GDN). It focuses on the spectral properties of the transition matrix to enhance the retrieval of long-range information. The authors identify key factors that affect performance, such as the alignment of slow spectral bands with target dependencies and the need for fast-decaying modes for effective context switching. By reparameterizing the alpha projections and adjusting learning rates, SpectralShift significantly boosts the long-context capabilities of linear attention models during continual pretraining.

zh.title: 谱重参数化提升长上下文能力
zh.desc: 最近，线性注意力层被越来越多地用于替代软最大注意力，以便在长上下文建模中进行大规模应用。现有的上下文扩展方法通常直接进行持续预训练，而不修改这些层，忽视了线性注意力状态动态的谱特性。本文从谱的角度研究了Gated DeltaNet（GDN）的长上下文扩展，识别出影响长距离信息检索的两个关键因素。基于这些观察，我们提出了SpectralShift，一种用于GDN的长上下文持续预训练的谱重参数化方法。

papers.title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
papers.abstract: Abstract  Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency. However, likelihood displacement motivates alternative ways to extract information from preference pairs with small likelihood margins. In this paper, we propose and analyze Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a zeroth-order alignment method based on comparison oracles. ComPO extracts directional information from these pairs without directly optimizing a differentiable preference loss on them. We establish a convergence guarantee for its basic offline scheme under smoothness, gradient sparsity, and compatibility between the oracle and a latent objective. We further introduce online ComPO, which retains the offline comparison mechanism and uses unlabeled policy generations for reverse-KL control relative to a reference policy. Following the coverage perspective of preference fine-tuning, we establish a performance guarantee for a basic constrained scheme under local coverage and in-distribution pairwise reward accuracy. Experiments on Mistral, Llama, Gemma-2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models demonstrate improvements over existing direct alignment methods, including length-controlled win rates, with pair-level diagnostics providing evidence consistent with mitigating likelihood displacement.

Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences (EECS), University of California, Berkeley
Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research (IEOR), Columbia University
Stern School of Business, New York University

ru.title: Оптимизация предпочтений через сравнение без дифференцирования
ru.desc: В работе предлагается Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO) — метод выравнивания больших языковых моделей, основанный на сравнении предпочтений без прямой оптимизации дифференцируемой функции потерь. Авторы анализируют сходимость офлайн-схемы при условиях гладкости и разреженности градиентов, а также вводят онлайн-версию с использованием немеченых сгенерированных примеров для контроля KL-дивергенции. Метод решает проблему смещения правдоподобия, извлекая направленную информацию из пар предпочтений с малыми различиями. Экспериментальные результаты на моделях Mistral, Llama, Gemma и Qwen показывают улучшение по сравнению с существующими методами выравнивания.

en.title: Aligning Language Models with Human Preferences Efficiently
en.desc: This paper introduces Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a new method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Unlike traditional methods that rely on optimizing a differentiable preference loss, ComPO uses comparison oracles to extract directional information from preference pairs. The authors provide a convergence guarantee for ComPO's offline scheme, ensuring it works well under certain conditions. Additionally, they present an online version of ComPO that leverages unlabeled policy generations, showing improved performance over existing alignment methods in various model experiments.

zh.title: 基于比较的偏好优化：提升语言模型对齐的效率
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的方法，称为基于比较的偏好优化（ComPO），用于将大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好对齐。ComPO通过比较oracle提取偏好对中的方向性信息，而不直接优化可微分的偏好损失。我们为其基本的离线方案建立了收敛保证，并引入了在线ComPO，利用无标签策略生成进行反向KL控制。实验结果表明，ComPO在多个模型上优于现有的直接对齐方法，改善了长度控制的胜率，并提供了与减轻似然位移一致的证据。

papers.title: Gaze as Evidence for Common Grounding: A Cross-Corpus Analysis of MapTask and MUNDEX
papers.abstract: Abstract  In collaborative tasks with asymmetric information, participants coordinate their understanding through interaction. We ask whether gaze provides evidence about grounding across two such tasks. Working from discrete behavioral annotations, we map HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991) and MUNDEX (Türk et al., 2023) into a shared partner/task/away vocabulary and compute gaze features around task-relevant dialogue units. In both corpora, aligned reference interpretations (MapTask) and UND (understood) judgments (MUNDEX) are associated with more task-directed gaze and with less partner-directed gaze, lower gaze entropy, and fewer gaze transitions. The associations are clearest for the participant leading the task: in giver-produced references, and in explainer judgments, which also co-vary with the explainee's gaze. In same-speaker MapTask reference chains, the speaker's gaze entropy is lower at the mention where a previously non-aligned referent becomes aligned. The best gaze feature groups improve modestly over controls under grouped cross-validation: temporal features in MapTask and raw proportions in MUNDEX. Because effects are small and several weaken when recurring participants rather than dialogues are the unit of inference, we treat gaze as one contributing cue to grounding, to be interpreted alongside task and dialogue context.

ru.title: Взгляд как сигнал общего понимания в диалоге
ru.desc: Исследователи изучают, может ли направление взгляда (gaze) служить показателем взаимного понимания в совместных задачах с асимметричной информацией. Они анализируют два корпуса диалогов (MapTask и MUNDEX), где участники координируют свои действия через речевое взаимодействие, и извлекают признаки направления взгляда вокруг задачно-релевантных единиц диалога. Результаты показывают, что согласованная интерпретация и понимание коррелируют с более задачно-направленным взглядом и меньшим количеством переводов взгляда на партнёра. Авторы делают вывод, что взгляд является одним из вспомогательных сигналов грундинга (достижения общего понимания) и должен интерпретироваться в контексте задачи и диалога.

en.title: Gaze as a Key Cue for Understanding in Collaborative Tasks
en.desc: This paper investigates how gaze behavior can indicate understanding in collaborative tasks where participants have different information. By analyzing gaze features in two specific tasks, the authors find that more focused gaze on task-related dialogue correlates with better alignment in understanding between participants. The study shows that the person leading the task exhibits less gaze variability when their references are understood by their partner. Overall, gaze is suggested to be a useful but modest cue for grounding communication, complementing other contextual factors in dialogue.

zh.title: 目光在协作任务中的理解作用
zh.desc: 在信息不对称的协作任务中，参与者通过互动协调他们的理解。本文研究了目光是否能提供关于任务理解的证据。通过分析HCRC MapTask和MUNDEX数据集中的目光特征，我们发现任务导向的目光与更少的伙伴导向目光、较低的目光熵和较少的目光转移相关。结果表明，目光是理解过程中的一个重要线索，但需要结合任务和对话的上下文进行解读。

papers.title: EventEgoHands++: Event-based Egocentric 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction with Real Dataset
papers.abstract: Abstract  3D hand mesh reconstruction is a challenging yet essential task for downstream applications, including human-robot interaction and AR/VR. Although conventional cameras have been widely adopted for this task, methods that rely on them struggle in low-light environments and under severe motion blur. To address these limitations, event-based cameras have recently attracted attention for their high dynamic range and high temporal resolution. However, applying event cameras to egocentric hand reconstruction remains challenging because camera wearer's motion produces dense background events that obscure hand-specific signals. Although the first egocentric event-based approach mitigates this issue using hand segmentation, its binary hand mask does not distinguish between left and right hands. As a result, the model lacks instance-level hand information and predicts both hands even when only one or neither hand is present. This limitation leads to incorrect inter-hand relationships and degraded reconstruction accuracy. In this paper, we propose EventEgoHands++, a framework for event-based 3D hand mesh reconstruction from an egocentric viewpoint. The proposed method incorporates a Hand Detector that estimates instance-level bounding boxes and masks for both the left and right hands. Moreover, we introduce Adaptive Attention, which dynamically gates the attention based on these detection results to accurately learn the spatial relationship and mutual interactions between the hands. To train and evaluate our framework, we extend the synthetic N-HOT3D dataset and newly construct EEH-R, the largest real-world event-based egocentric hand dataset to date, comprising approximately 1M annotated frames captured in environments including low-light conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baselines.
affiliations: Graduate School of Science and Technology, Keio University

ru.title: Определение левой и правой руки для точной реконструкции 3D сетки рук из event-камер
ru.desc: В работе предлагается EventEgoHands++, фреймворк для реконструкции 3D сетки рук с эгоцентрической точки зрения с использованием event-камер. Метод решает проблему различения левой и правой руки путём применения детектора рук, который предсказывает instance-level ограничивающие боксы и маски для каждой руки отдельно. Авторы вводят механизм адаптивного внимания (Adaptive Attention), который динамически управляет вниманием на основе результатов детекции для точного изучения пространственных отношений между руками. Для обучения и оценки методов авторы создали новый большой датасет EEH-R с примерно 1 млн аннотированных кадров, включая сложные условия слабого освещения.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Hand Reconstruction with Event-Based Cameras
en.desc: This paper presents EventEgoHands++, a novel framework for reconstructing 3D hand meshes using event-based cameras from an egocentric perspective. The method addresses challenges in distinguishing between left and right hands by incorporating a Hand Detector that provides instance-level bounding boxes and masks. Additionally, it employs Adaptive Attention to enhance the model's ability to learn spatial relationships and interactions between the hands. The framework is trained and evaluated on an extensive dataset, showing significant improvements in reconstruction accuracy over previous methods.

zh.title: 基于事件的3D手部重建新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为EventEgoHands++的框架，用于从自我中心视角进行基于事件的3D手部网格重建。该方法通过手部检测器估计左右手的实例级边界框和掩码，解决了传统方法在低光照和运动模糊下的局限性。我们还引入了自适应注意力机制，根据检测结果动态调整注意力，以准确学习手部之间的空间关系和相互作用。通过扩展合成N-HOT3D数据集并构建EEH-R数据集，我们的实验表明该方法在多个数据集上均优于基线模型。

papers.title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies. The broad agentic capabilities of commercial vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-6 Astra, raise a compelling question: can these models learn from demonstrations, examples, and interaction feedback, then translate that information into executable and verifiable robot behavior from a new initial state without gradient updates or persistent changes to task-specific parameters? We introduce GPT-Policy, a general-agent framework for in-context robot learning. GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome. We evaluate its reliability and limitations through task success and efficiency metrics, matched comparisons across models, and controlled context ablations. In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks. These findings position GPT-Policy as a step toward robot adaptation through in-context learning, providing an empirical foundation for translating the general-purpose capabilities of VLMs into physical behavior and clarifying the challenges that must be overcome for reliable deployment.
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Роботы учатся через контекст: превращение языковых моделей в физические действия
ru.desc: В статье представляется GPT-Policy — фреймворк для обучения роботов через контекстное обучение (ICL), который позволяет роботам адаптироваться к новым задачам без обновления градиентов. Система интегрирует компилятор контекста для сохранения визуальной информации о задачах, большую мультимодальную модель для генерации действий робота и верификационный контроллер для безопасного исполнения. Авторы демонстрируют, что человеческие видеодемонстрации значительно улучшают выполнение задач роботом в реальном мире, даже без явных разметок действий. Исследование показывает потенциал и ограничения использования Vision-Language моделей для управления физическими роботами в условиях неопределённости.

en.title: Empowering Robots with In-Context Learning for Adaptability
en.desc: This paper presents GPT-Policy, a framework that enables robots to learn and adapt to new tasks in real-time using in-context learning (ICL). It leverages commercial vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret demonstrations and feedback, allowing robots to execute actions without needing to retrain their parameters. The framework includes a context compiler for visual transitions, a VLM for action proposals, and a controller for action verification. The results show that human demonstrations can significantly enhance task performance, highlighting the potential of ICL for improving robotic adaptability in unfamiliar environments.

zh.title: 机器人适应性的新突破：GPT-Policy框架
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了如何使机器人在不熟悉的环境中适应，目标是实现类人智能的能力。我们提出了一种名为GPT-Policy的框架，利用上下文学习（ICL）来提高机器人的适应性。该框架结合了上下文编译器、视觉语言模型（VLM）和受限控制器，以实现从示例和反馈中学习并执行机器人行为。通过实验证明，GPT-Policy能够在没有任务特定参数的情况下，提升机器人的任务完成率和效率。

papers.title: PANORAMA: Panoptic Grounded Captioning via Mask Proposal Selection
papers.abstract: Abstract  Intelligent systems that act in the world require image understanding that is both comprehensive and spatially grounded. Current vision-language models (VLMs) can generate fluent and detailed image captions, but reliably associating them with image pixels remains challenging. Existing methods that combine dense captioning with pixel-level grounding often produce either incomplete descriptions or inaccurate segmentation masks. We study this problem through panoptic grounded captioning, a task that requires a VLM to describe both foreground objects and background regions while grounding each referring phrase with pixel-level masks. We make three contributions. First, we introduce PanoCaps, a human-annotated benchmark constructed from panoptic segmentation datasets. It provides dense captions with near-complete pixel coverage and image-text alignments at the entity level, supporting both training and evaluation. We further propose a phrase-mask matching protocol and a generalized Panoptic Quality (gPQ) metric that jointly evaluates textual and mask agreement. Second, we formulate phrase grounding as selection from a phrase-conditioned pool of mask proposals and introduce PANORAMA, a VLM that conditions a pretrained segmenter on contextualized phrase representations to obtain candidate masks and learns to select those corresponding to each phrase. Training this interface jointly with caption generation enables PANORAMA to produce high-quality masks while allowing each phrase to refer to a single region or multiple instances. Third, PANORAMA achieves the best overall grounding on PanoCaps and matches or exceeds specialized models across several pixel-level grounding tasks. Experiments show that our method produces precise entity-level segmentations while maintaining detailed, mask-consistent captions. Code, data and models are available at https://www.di.ens.fr/willow/research/panorama/.
affiliations: Czech Institute of Informatics, Robotics and Cybernetics

ru.title: Точное связывание описаний с пиксельными масками через паноптическую сегментацию
ru.desc: В работе решается задача паноптического грounded captioning, где требуется описать объекты переднего плана и фоновые области изображения с выравниванием каждой фразы описания к пиксельным маскам. Авторы представляют датасет PanoCaps с плотными аннотациями и разработали метод PANORAMA, основанный на vision-language модели, которая условирует предобученный сегментатор на контекстуализированных представлениях фраз для получения кандидатов масок. Модель обучается совместно генерировать подробные подписи и выбирать маски, соответствующие каждой фразе, что позволяет связывать одну фразу с одной областью или несколькими экземплярами объектов. PANORAMA достигает лучших результатов в выравнивании текста и маск на уровне пикселей, превосходя специализированные модели на нескольких бенчмарках.

en.title: Enhancing Image Understanding with Panoptic Grounded Captioning
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of associating image captions with specific pixels in images, which is crucial for intelligent systems. The authors introduce a new task called panoptic grounded captioning, which requires models to describe both objects and backgrounds while accurately linking phrases to pixel masks. They present PanoCaps, a benchmark dataset that provides detailed captions and pixel alignments for training and evaluation. Additionally, they propose a new model, PANORAMA, which effectively generates high-quality segmentations and captions by conditioning on contextualized phrase representations, achieving superior performance in grounding tasks.

zh.title: 全景基础描述：图像理解的新突破
zh.desc: 本论文研究了智能系统在图像理解中的挑战，特别是如何将图像描述与像素级别的语义关联。我们提出了一种新的任务，称为全景基础描述，要求模型同时描述前景物体和背景区域，并为每个描述短语提供像素级掩码。为此，我们引入了PanoCaps基准数据集，并提出了一种新的评估指标和匹配协议。我们的模型PANORAMA在图像分割和描述生成方面表现优异，能够生成高质量的掩码和详细的描述。

papers.title: Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.abstract: Abstract  Training a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model at long context or large batch size fails as soon as any one component's peak allocation exceeds device memory, so the target is every peak at once, not the average footprint. Four are left unbounded by the parallelism plans in common use, and each grows differently: expert dispatch with the routing matrix, the vocabulary projection with tokens times vocabulary, gradient checkpoint boundaries with depth times sequence length, and optimizer state with parameter count. Which one runs out first changes with the model, the context length, and the device count, so lowering the largest only exposes the next. We bound all four with schedules whose GPU working set is fixed at launch: PipelinedLLEP extends least-loaded expert parallelism with a cap on the tokens each source contributes to a dispatch chunk, Ring-DTP circulates activations or weight shards around a ring at the vocabulary projection and folds each block of logits into an online log-sum-exp, Selective checkpoint offload (SCO) keeps the one long-lived tensor of each checkpoint boundary in CPU memory, and OffloadStreamAdamW turns the serial CPU Adam update of optimizer offload into a bucket pipeline. All four change only the order and granularity of computation and data movement, so the loss and gradients stay exact. In matched component tests, they cut the MoE dispatch peak by up to 59.3% without losing throughput, the vocabulary projection peak by 86.6%, and the offloaded optimizer step by 2.05times faster. Composed on MoE models from 120B to 667B parameters, they train at 1M context length, 8--32times the reach of a tuned FSDP2 baseline, and up to 10.4times its throughput.

ru.title: Четыре способа приручить пиковую память при тренировке гигантских смешанных экспертов
ru.desc: В этой работе предложены четыре метода для тренировки очень больших Mixture-of-Experts моделей с длинным контекстом и большим размером батча, которые уменьшают пиковое потребление памяти на GPU. Авторы выявили четыре критических места, где память может закончиться: распределение экспертов через матрицу маршрутизации, проекция словаря на токены, контрольные точки градиентов и состояние оптимизатора. Предложенные методы (PipelinedLLEP, Ring-DTP, SCO и OffloadStreamAdamW) переупорядочивают вычисления и перемещение данных без изменения точности градиентов, достигая уменьшения пиковой памяти на 59-87% для разных компонентов. На практике эти методы позволили тренировать модели от 120B до 667B параметров с контекстом в 1 миллион токенов, что в 8-32 раза больше, чем базовые подходы.

en.title: Optimizing Memory Usage in Mixture-of-Experts Training
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenges of training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models when dealing with long contexts or large batch sizes, particularly when memory limits are exceeded. It introduces four innovative scheduling techniques to manage memory usage effectively: PipelinedLLEP, Ring-DTP, Selective checkpoint offload (SCO), and OffloadStreamAdamW. These methods optimize the allocation of resources without compromising the accuracy of loss and gradients, allowing for significant reductions in peak memory usage. The proposed solutions enable training of large MoE models with improved efficiency, achieving higher throughput and longer context lengths compared to existing methods.

zh.title: 优化混合专家模型的内存使用与训练效率
zh.desc: 本文讨论了一种混合专家模型（MoE）的训练方法，旨在解决在长上下文或大批量大小下的内存限制问题。通过四种不同的调度策略，本文有效地限制了模型在训练过程中的内存峰值使用，确保每个组件的内存使用不超过设备的限制。所提出的方法包括管道化的最少负载专家并行、环形激活传递、选择性检查点卸载和优化器状态的流式处理，这些方法在不影响计算精度的情况下，显著降低了内存峰值。最终，这些技术使得MoE模型在大规模参数下的训练效率大幅提升，达到了更高的吞吐量和更长的上下文长度。

papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.abstract: Abstract  Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0   serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.

ru.title: Предсказательная маршрутизация для эффективного вывода MoE на слабом железе
ru.desc: В этой работе предлагается Edge0 — система для эффективного вывода Mixture-of-Experts моделей на потребительском оборудовании с ограниченной памятью. Основная идея заключается в использовании прероутера, который предсказывает маршрутизацию экспертов для следующего слоя на один токен вперёд, что позволяет спрятать задержки чтения с SSD за вычислениями. Модель использует квантизацию int4 и обучает LoRA адаптер для компенсации потери качества от замены маршрутизации. На практике система достигает пропускной способности 20 токенов в секунду для 35B MoE модели при пиковом потреблении памяти всего 3 ГБ, что близко к качеству полноточной модели.

en.title: Streamlining Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Inference
en.desc: This paper introduces Edge0, a streaming inference engine designed for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models that optimizes memory usage on consumer hardware. It addresses the challenge of weight memory limitations by implementing a prerouter that predicts the routing of experts one token ahead, allowing for efficient processing without dropping any data. The system utilizes an unmerged recovery LoRA to compensate for quality loss due to quantization and routing changes. Edge0 demonstrates impressive performance, serving a 35B MoE model at 20 tokens per second while maintaining low memory usage and competitive accuracy across multiple benchmarks.

zh.title: Edge0：高效的流式混合专家推理引擎
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了一种名为Edge0的流式混合专家（MoE）推理引擎，旨在解决在消费者硬件上进行MoE推理时的内存限制问题。传统方法在选择专家时存在延迟，导致无法有效利用计算资源，而Edge0通过预路由机制提前预测下一层的路由，从而提高了效率。该方法在一台24GB的机器上实现了35B MoE模型的推理，内存使用峰值仅为3GiB，且在多个基准测试中表现接近其fp16教师模型。Edge0的框架和适配器都是开源的，支持8B级别的模型运行。

papers.title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Current Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) paradigms generally treat query routing and agent fine-tuning as separate processes, limiting their ability to respond to evolving agent capabilities. This disconnect prevents routing strategies from adapting to evolving agent capabilities during post-training and prevents agents from achieving synergistic data-driven specialization. To resolve this, we introduce CERA-MoA (Co-Evolving Router with continually learning Agents for Mixture-of-Agents), an iterative reinforcement learning framework where the dynamic router and independent agent policies co-evolve. We design a predictive familiarity estimator that leverages mid-layer hidden states to evaluate semantic competence among agents, avoiding the overhead of full rollouts. Based on these familiarity scores, a cumulative-threshold adaptive routing mechanism dynamically activates a tailored minimal agent subset, achieving a trade-off between task performance and efficiency. By proactively allocating targeted training samples to agents based on their evolving competence, CERA-MoA promotes capability differentiation. Extensive experiments across various domains demonstrate that CERA-MoA outperforms state-of-the-art static-agent routing and fix-workflow fine-tuning baselines.
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China
Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute, Shanghai, China

ru.title: Совместная эволюция маршрутизатора и агентов для адаптивной смеси агентов
ru.desc: В работе предложен CERA-MoA — фреймворк на основе обучения с подкреплением, где маршрутизатор и агенты совместно развиваются, адаптируясь друг к другу. Авторы разработали предсказывающий оцениватель компетентности, который анализирует скрытые состояния нейросети для оценки семантических возможностей агентов без полного прохода по траекториям. На основе оценок компетентности применяется адаптивный механизм маршрутизации, который динамически активирует минимальное подмножество агентов, балансируя качество и эффективность. Система целенаправленно распределяет обучающие примеры агентам согласно их развивающимся способностям, что способствует специализации агентов и превосходит существующие статические подходы.

en.title: Co-Evolving Agents for Enhanced Performance and Efficiency
en.desc: The paper presents CERA-MoA, a new framework that improves how agents in a Mixture-of-Agents system are managed and trained. It combines the processes of query routing and agent fine-tuning, allowing them to adapt together as agents develop new skills. By using a predictive familiarity estimator, the framework assesses each agent's competence and dynamically selects the best agents for specific tasks. This approach not only enhances performance but also increases efficiency by ensuring that agents receive training that matches their evolving capabilities.

zh.title: 协同进化，提升代理能力的智能路由
zh.desc: 当前的混合代理（MoA）方法通常将查询路由和代理微调视为独立的过程，这限制了它们对代理能力变化的响应能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CERA-MoA（协同进化路由器与持续学习代理的混合代理），这是一个迭代强化学习框架，其中动态路由器和独立代理策略共同进化。我们设计了一种预测熟悉度估计器，利用中间层隐藏状态评估代理之间的语义能力，从而避免了完全回滚的开销。通过根据代理的能力变化主动分配目标训练样本，CERA-MoA促进了能力的差异化。

papers.title: Assessing nnU-Net Generalization across Brain Tumor Populations in BraTS-GoAT 2026
papers.abstract: Abstract  BraTS-GoAT evaluates tumor segmentation across heterogeneous populations. We trained a conventional 3D nnU-Net on 1,351 labeled cases using five-fold cross-validation and 1,000 epochs per fold. The final predictor averaged all folds and applied test-time mirroring. On pooled official validation, global DSC values were 0.7805, 0.8288, and 0.8854 for enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT). Under matched fold-0 inference, mean regional Dice decreased from 0.9058 on source out-of-fold (OOF) cases to 0.8310 on pooled validation (difference--0.0747). Mirroring gave small single-fold gains but no clear ensemble benefit; a residual-encoder alternative reached 0.8282 mean Dice. In labeled OOF predictions, failure cases had substantially smaller reference ET volumes; after adjustment for ET and WT volume, lower Dice remained associated with more disconnected ET components and a smaller fraction of ET contained in the largest component.
affiliations: ICube Laboratory, CNRS UMR 7357, University of Strasbourg

ru.title: Сегментация опухолей в разнородных данных: преодоление разрыва между обучением и практикой
ru.desc: Статья посвящена оценке сегментации опухолей мозга в разнородных популяциях пациентов с использованием модели 3D nnU-Net. Авторы обучили нейронную сеть на 1,351 размеченных случаях с применением пятикратной кросс-валидации, достигнув значений Dice коэффициента 0.7805-0.8854 для разных типов опухоли. Анализ показал значительное снижение производительности при переносе модели на валидационный набор данных, что указывает на проблему обобщаемости. Выяснилось, что основные ошибки сегментации связаны с малыми объемами опухолей и фрагментированной структурой опухолевых компонентов.

en.title: Enhancing Tumor Segmentation with BraTS-GoAT
en.desc: The paper presents BraTS-GoAT, a method for evaluating tumor segmentation in diverse patient populations using a 3D nnU-Net model. The model was trained on 1,351 labeled cases with five-fold cross-validation, achieving high global Dice Similarity Coefficients (DSC) for different tumor types. Despite some improvements from test-time mirroring, the overall performance showed a decrease in mean regional Dice for out-of-fold cases compared to pooled validation. The study highlights that smaller tumor volumes and disconnected components negatively impact segmentation accuracy, emphasizing the need for robust models in heterogeneous datasets.

zh.title: 肿瘤分割的智能评估
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了BraTS-GoAT，一个用于评估肿瘤分割的机器学习模型。我们使用了1351个标记案例，通过五折交叉验证和每折1000个训练周期来训练一个传统的3D nnU-Net模型。最终的预测结果在官方验证集上显示，增强肿瘤、肿瘤核心和整个肿瘤的全局Dice相似度分别为0.7805、0.8288和0.8854。研究还发现，在源外折预测中，平均区域Dice值下降，且较小的增强肿瘤体积与较低的Dice值相关。

papers.title: Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand
papers.abstract: Abstract  A walking robotic hand must use the same fingers to move its body, support its weight, and interact with the environment. We show how an anthropomorphic hand can learn these skills while retaining its finger design and position controller. Onboard power and computation make the platform self-contained. Our reinforcement learning approach accounts for the hand's unequal fingers, with training in a simulator calibrated from hardware measurements. In simulation, the hand moves faster with our reward formulation than with tuned rewards originally designed for quadrupeds. On hardware, task-specific policies enable untethered crawling, steering, and fall recovery. While supporting its own weight, the hand also executes successive keyboard commands without vision and pushes an object to targets using overhead visual feedback. These results demonstrate a compact mobile manipulator that reuses its fingers for locomotion and interaction, without a separate locomotion mechanism.

ru.title: Рука, которая ходит: переучивание пальцев для локомоции и манипуляции
ru.desc: В работе описывается антропоморфная робототехническая рука, которая обучается одновременно передвигаться и взаимодействовать с окружением, используя одни и те же пальцы для обеих задач. Авторы применяют метод обучения с подкреплением с разработкой специальной функции вознаграждения, учитывающей асимметричное строение пальцев руки. Обучение проводится в симуляторе, калиброванном на основе измерений реального оборудования, что позволяет получить политики управления лучше, чем эвристические методы из робототехники четвероногих. На практике робот демонстрирует навыки самостоятельного передвижения, управления направлением движения, восстановления после падения и манипуляции предметами, создавая компактный мобильный манипулятор без отдельного механизма локомоции.

en.title: One Hand, Many Skills: A Robotic Hand for Movement and Interaction
en.desc: This paper presents a novel approach for a walking robotic hand that utilizes its fingers for both locomotion and interaction with the environment. The authors employ reinforcement learning to train the hand, taking into account the unique design and control of its fingers. By calibrating the simulation with real hardware measurements, they achieve improved performance in movement speed compared to traditional reward systems. The results show that the robotic hand can effectively crawl, steer, and recover from falls while performing tasks like typing and object manipulation without the need for additional locomotion mechanisms.

zh.title: 智能手指：行走与互动的完美结合
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了一种行走的机器人手，它能够利用相同的手指来移动身体、支撑重量和与环境互动。研究者展示了一个类人手如何在保持手指设计和位置控制器的情况下学习这些技能。通过强化学习的方法，考虑到手指的不等长，训练在一个基于硬件测量的模拟器中进行。实验结果表明，该手在模拟中移动速度更快，并且在硬件上能够实现无缝爬行、转向和恢复平衡，同时在不依赖视觉的情况下执行键盘命令。

papers.title: Fathom: Per-Query Read Depth for Sparse Decoding over Offloaded KV Caches
papers.abstract: Abstract  When agentic sessions run to a million tokens with many sessions resident at once, the KV cache and the index that ranks it live in host memory, and the scan that ranks all n keys for a top-k step becomes the traffic that bounds decoding. We present Fathom, a key scan in which each query decides how many bits of each key channel to read. The 4-bit K cache is stored channel-major as bit planes, so a prefix of t planes is exactly the channel's t-bit quantizer, and the query spends its bit budget by reverse water-filling over the variance-weighted importance of its channels. At one million tokens on Qwen3-8B a decode step is 1.67x faster in GPU time than with the 136-bit scans of Double Sparsity, Loki and SparQ r=32, and in the same GPU time as SparQ's 68-bit read (r=16) Fathom reads 18% fewer bytes with lower attention error on six of seven model and context settings. On RULER-style tasks every per-token scan matches exact top-k decoding, and on real coding-agent sessions Fathom reaches the step agreement of the most accurate 136-bit scan at 92 bits. The store is the 4-bit K copy a quantized serving stack already holds, and the method is not faster when the index is resident in GPU memory.

ru.title: Адаптивное битовое сканирование для эффективного декодирования на больших сессиях
ru.desc: Статья представляет Fathom, новый метод оптимизации сканирования KV-кэша при декодировании больших языковых моделей. Авторы предлагают адаптивное чтение битов ключей, где каждый запрос независимо решает, сколько бит прочитать из каждого канала, используя стратегию обратного заполнения водой. Метод использует 4-битное квантование KV-кэша с хранением по плоскостям битов, что позволяет достичь ускорения на 1.67x при обработке миллионов токенов по сравнению с существующими методами. На практических задачах Fathom достигает качества детально настроенных сканов с 136 битами, читая при этом на 18% меньше данных из памяти.

en.title: Fathom: Speeding Up Decoding with Smart Key Scanning
en.desc: This paper introduces Fathom, a new method for efficiently scanning key-value (KV) caches in machine learning models during decoding. Fathom allows each query to determine how many bits to read from each key channel, optimizing the use of memory and improving speed. By using a 4-bit KV cache stored in a channel-major format, Fathom achieves faster decoding times and reduces the amount of data read compared to existing methods. The results show that Fathom not only speeds up the decoding process but also maintains high accuracy in various tasks, making it a significant advancement in the field.

zh.title: Fathom：提升解码效率的新方法
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为Fathom的关键扫描方法，旨在提高大规模会话中的解码效率。Fathom通过让每个查询决定读取每个键通道的位数，从而优化了KV缓存的使用。与传统的136位扫描方法相比，Fathom在解码速度上提高了1.67倍，并且在多个模型和上下文设置中减少了18%的字节读取量。该方法在RULER风格的任务中实现了与精确的top-k解码相匹配的性能，展示了其在实际编码代理会话中的有效性。
